notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.16.3
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
- Fixed a bug where "Rolf's Statement" can be obtained repeatedly
- Fixed a bug where presenting certain wrong contradictions to Yan may cause errors

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.16.2
notes.notes:
[Bug Fixes]
- Fixed a bug where the "Master Logician" Achievement could not be unlocked if have previously failed the deduction sequence
- Fixed a bug where Rolf's Yan-as-a-crow comic would re-appear and get stuck on screen upon multiple saves and loads with an on-screen comic panel.
- More typo fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.16 [Moving locations no longer costs AP]
notes.notes:
[Design Change] 
- Following player feedback, after some consideration, we made it so that moving location in the game *no longer* costs AP. We hope this will make gameplay smoother and give you the chance to explore more stories in the game!

[Changes]
- Following the AP change, tutorial has been changed accordingly, and slight changes have been made to the 10am Moses scene to accommodate for more actions. 

[Bug Fixes]
- Fixed a bug where the sunset background was incorrectly displayed for the Fair scene when the player ends 12:00 Detective scene in Fortune Teller or Big Top
- Fixed a bug where opening and quickly closing the map will leave the scene silent without BGM
- Fixed minor typos in English
- Fixed wrong controller button instructions for log on the bottom right of the controller UI
- Disabled resizable window to prevent resolution issues

notes.title: Discord Murder Mystery Party + Release Date Announcement Coming Soon 🎪
notes.notes:
The release date for Death Trick: Double Blind will be announced very soon…  and to celebrate, Neon Doctrine is hosting a Murder Mystery RPG Event on their Discord server: https://discord.gg/nd

Date: March 1, 2024 1:30 AM UTC

Sign Up:  Fill out this form to sign up - https://forms.gle/Ph1aW9w3iFaXNJtr8

Once you sign up, you’ll be assigned a character and sent a character sheet to prepare for the event!

About the Campaign - (The Curious Carnival by Foulplay Games) 
You have been cordially invited to the centennial birthday of Vanya and Vaska Kalderash, the famed fortune telling twins of The Curious Carnival. 🎪 

Not everything looks like it will be fun and games though; rumor has it, not everyone is happy with the current ringmaster, Esmeralda Petrovic, and there are whispers of impossible feats taking place outside of the tents. not to mention the gossip that the circus is peddling something more than entertainment... 🔎 

The night is bound to be a showstopper, so come along and experience the magic up close. ✨ 

Don't forget to Wishlist the game if you haven't already, and we look forward to seeing you all at the event! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2254710/Death_Trick_Double_Blind/

notes.title: Development Update (& Eastern Games Fest Announcement)
notes.notes:
Hi fellow detectives,

We are excited to share that Death Trick: Double Blind is a part of Eastern games fest, hosted by Steam China! 

Click here ↓ to add it to your wishlist now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2254710/Death_Trick_Double_Blind/


We also want to share some updates on what we've been busy with lately:

We've just completed a small beta playtest with some players in our great community, and collected a lot of valuable feedback. 

We have been working to make some changes and adjustments according to the beta test feedback, as well as working on a brand new trailer to be released with the demo. We are making great progress with both and rest assured you will see our brand new demo and trailer within a month (promise!)

At the same time, we've also started slowly updating all of our art assets to 4k for the future complete version of the game, so you will be able to enjoy the game in higher resolution if you wish :)

For now, see you in Eastern games fest :)
